Exterprise has extensive experience implementing ServiceNow's Customer Service Management solution. Predictive Intelligence classifies incoming cases by issue type and priority automatically, while Advanced Work Assignment routes each case to the agent best equipped to handle it based on skills, availability, and workload — now extended further with AI Agents that can resolve routine requests without waiting on a human agent.

Exterprise's team of CSM experts configure Case Management and integrate multiple customer data sources with backend processes across the organization — covering front, middle, and back offices — so Advanced Work Assignment routing always has the full picture, and a case never gets stuck at a hand-off.

Where customers actually experience CSM

Three applications underneath the highlights above do most of the work — configured around your actual service model, not a generic template.

CASE MANAGEMENT

One case, tracked end to end

Case Management handles intake, SLAs, and interactions in one place — including cases outsourced to third parties — while Predictive Intelligence classifies and prioritizes each case automatically as it comes in.

OMNI-CHANNEL ENGAGEMENT

Every channel, one queue

Advanced Work Assignment routes email, chat, phone, and portal interactions to the agent best equipped to handle them, based on skills, availability, and capacity — with IntegrationHub connecting to CRM, CCaaS, and ERP systems.

CSM PORTAL

Self-service that shows the full picture

B2B customers manage their own cases, view entitlements, and access knowledge directly — with account hierarchy and contract visibility built in, not bolted on.
